script: Do you want your own AI studio at home, running on a laptop or an old desktop? In this course you will prepare your machine, run local language models, make images and voice-overs, generate short video clips, and edit a complete YouTube video. No monthly subscriptions are needed for the tools. Let's begin.
glossary: Ollama, Open WebUI, ComfyUI, NVIDIA, VRAM, LUFS, DaVinci Resolve, Kdenlive, Ubuntu, Windows 11, WSL2, FFmpeg, nvidia-smi, BIOS, GPU, B-roll, YouTube
